clips.title: The story
paras: Nighthaven is a secluded settlement resting on the northern shores of Lake Elune'ara in Moonglade. Serving as the heart of the Cenarion Circle, it is a haven where night elf and tauren druids study together in peace beyond the factional wars of Azeroth.

Built with traditional night elf architecture along the calm shores of Lake Elune'ara, Nighthaven is a tranquil retreat largely secluded from the outside world. Here, moonwells cast a gentle glow over groves and halls dedicated to preserving the natural balance. As the primary enclave of the Cenarion Circle, it provides trainers, herbalists, and specialized suppliers for druidic initiates. The settlement maintains a strict neutrality, welcoming practitioners regardless of whether their home loyalties lie with the Alliance or the Horde.

Nighthaven's peace has been tested throughout history. Centuries after the War of the Ancients, champions gathered here to confront the enraged demigod Omen, driving him beneath the depths of Lake Elune'ara. The village also opens its secluded borders during the Lunar Festival, welcoming pilgrims from all over Azeroth to honor the ancestors and celebrate under Elune's watchful gaze.
